items.title: Edmond "Doc" Souchon Interview, 1962-02-17
items.q: he has had a very severe ulcer which I fooled around with for about three or four years and I finally got him in the hands of a good internist

ctx.x: Well I think of it do you have any information on Arnold Licano? Last time I saw Papa Lane it's been three or four months now maybe. He said that Arnold Licano was so sick.

Well he's not to the point of dying but he has had a very severe ulcer which I fooled around with for about three or four years and I finally got him in the hands of a good internist who's treating him and he's better.
Do you think he could be interviewed again? We have that interview you very kindly let us copy
